raw_response:
I will keep my farm simple and steady this year. I am 70, there are only two people in my household, and I have farmed this land for 50 years, so I will not chase a complicated plan. I will put most of my 9 mu into the wheat-maize rotation because it fits my land, my irrigation conditions, and my experience in Quzhou County. That system gives me stable grain output and makes full use of the year. I will still keep a smaller cotton area for cash income, but I will limit it because cotton needs more labor and more plant protection work. Since I have well irrigation and enough farming knowledge, I will use better seed, moderate fertilizer, and a manageable number of irrigations and sprays. I will aim for stable yield rather than maximum yield, because at my age I care more about reliability, labor control, and avoiding waste.
